title: CUPE 791 contract and building code services
subtitle: Special meeting also authorized a closed session on a labour relations matter and confirmed proceedings.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on April 24, 2025. It approved a new collective agreement with CUPE 791 and authorized staff to provide building code services to other Ontario municipalities.

After a closed session on a labour relations matter, Council approved the terms of the Memorandum of Settlement dated April 10, 2025. The agreement covers 2025-2029 {{vote:m3}}. The same terms will extend to non-union staff, and part-time and casual staff will receive a wage adjustment only. This sets the city's labour costs and workforce stability for the next several years.

Council also authorized the CAO or the General Manager of Development Services to sign agreements to provide Building Code Act services to other municipalities for a limited time {{vote:m1}}. This applies only if Kitchener's Chief Building Official finds the city has the capacity. The City Solicitor must be satisfied with the agreements. The aim is to help other municipalities while keeping local service in place.

decisions.item: Building code services for other municipalities
decisions.detail: The CAO or General Manager of Development Services may sign time-limited agreements to provide Building Code Act services to other Ontario municipalities, if the Chief Building Official confirms capacity and the City Solicitor is satisfied.

Council approved the terms of the 2025-2029 Memorandum of Settlement with CUPE 791, extended them to non-union staff (part-time and casual staff receive wage adjustment only), and authorized the Mayor and Clerk to sign the documents.
